description: Expected values for the chunk-offsets format (kit 0.8.0 plan section 4), built by scripts/golden/chunk_offsets_ref.py from the design alone. Hex strings are lowercase. Proofs use the wire form of SPEC-MERKLE-OBJECTS 5.2 (big-endian leaf count, minimal varint count, siblings). Bundles are KDPB version 3 and spans KDSP version 2. 'refused_by' is a label of the check that fails first, not a Rust error name.

leaf_digests.comment: plan 4.3: L[0] with le64(total_size) and le32(chunk_size) at asymmetric maxima; a big-endian or swapped field fails

leaf_digests.comment: plan 4.3/4.4: L[0] of the empty file

leaf_digests.name: chunk_asymmetric_max
leaf_digests.comment: plan 4.3: L[i + 1] = domain_digest(chunk-v1, le64(start) || le64(end) || id); start and end differ and are near u64::MAX

leaf_digests.name: chunk_start_end_swapped
leaf_digests.comment: plan 4.3: the same two values swapped give another digest (start before end in the body)

leaf_digests.comment: plan 4.3: low values; every byte of start and end distinct from the high bytes
